smt-2013-general-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Compute all real nonzero values of $b$ such that $bx^2-bx-b=0$ has $b$ as a solution.

smt-2013-general-tiebreaker-02.prompt: Leo is at the bottom left corner of the grid. If he can only walk up and to the right, how many different paths can he take to the upper right corner?

smt-2013-general-tiebreaker-03.prompt: The lines $y=2x+1$, $y=-\frac12x+6$, and $y=-2x-3$ split the plane into multiple regions. One of the regions has finite area. Compute the area of that region.
